title: How much does AI impact development speed?
summary: Abi Noda summarizes Google's RCT: AI features cut task time by about 21% (wide CI), with no differential benefit by seniority or prior AI use.

assertions.quote: AI tools may reduce task completion time by around 21% in enterprise settings
More senior developers were faster overall, but they didn’t disproportionately benefit from AI.
developers who had frequently used AI tools in the past didn’t complete tasks significantly faster
The largest speed gains from AI were observed among developers who code more hours per day.

verdicts.note: Google's RCT found a large but not statistically significant interaction, so it is suggestive only.

Copilot RCT heterogeneity analysis: developers with more coding hours per day benefited more, along with less experienced and older developers. The sample is small (95 Upwork freelancers) and the regression coefficients are imprecise.

Google RCT: the interaction between AI and coding 5+ hours a day was large and negative (beta = -0.29, faster with AI) but not significant (model p = 0.018). The authors call it tentative evidence that heavy coders gain more.

assertions.quote: developers have to carefully check and fix the code the AI suggests
